chief_complaint: Management of hypertension and associated metabolic risk factors (obesity, prediabetes) with attention to anxiety and anemia.

Severe panic‑type anxiety emerged in December 2023, coinciding with a transition from full‑time to part‑time employment and a recent report of limited social contact (January 2025). Blood pressure is currently 126/84 mmHg (stage 1 hypertension) while heart rate is 93 bpm. Latest HbA1c is 6.2% (prediabetic). Lipid profile, eGFR, and exact BMI are unavailable. The patient is on lisinopril and hydrochlorothiazide for blood pressure control; no statin, metformin, or anxiolytic therapy is documented. Preventive care visits are frequent (9 wellness visits), but acute care encounters are few. Recent dental disease was resolved in January 2025. Overall, the clinical trajectory shows persistent cardiometabolic risk with gaps in guideline‑directed therapy and emerging psychosocial stressors.
